title: Encoding Inequity: Examining Demographic Bias in LLM-Driven Robot Caregiving
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith/religion. It focused on demographic bias related to sex, gender, sexuality, race, ethnicity, nationality, disability, and age.
findings: The paper did not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
